setup.description: Install and verify devbox, select its version, and publish its environment for subsequent tasks.

version.description: Tool release or supported channel to install; omitted values use the documented default.

installDir.description: Absolute per-user installation prefix; omit for native package installations.

packageName.description: Native package or port selector overriding the default repository package name.

sudo.description: Use noninteractive sudo for native package or system installation; defaults to false.

packages.description: Package selectors to install, optionally with per-package versions using the selected manager’s syntax; omitted or empty lists install only the manager.

project.description: Project environment directory to initialize or update; defaults to the current directory. Creates or updates the manager manifest and lockfile when packages are supplied.
